blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is crucial for autonomous driving, but camera-based methods degrade in low-light conditions and LiDAR-based methods are sensitive to adverse weather. 4D radar is more robust, yet its sparsity and the high cost of radar tensor processing limit its use. We propose Radar Geometric-Semantic Occupancy Prediction (RadarGSOcc), an efficient framework that directly processes 4D radar tensors by separately extracting geometric and semantic features, including Doppler information, with a deformable attention-based geometric refinement module as its key component. We also introduce the K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark, the first large-scale benchmark for 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors, built on the K-Radar dataset with refined LiDAR-based annotations. RadarGSOcc predicts 15 classes within a 51.2m range and achieves 38.2% IoU, 7.6% mIoU, and 25.5% weighted mIoU, outperforming RadarOcc by 17% relative (25.5 vs. 21.9) in weighted mIoU while using fewer parameters and lower computation. It substantially improves truck prediction while trading off car accuracy, outperforms camera-based approaches, and narrows the gap with LiDAR-based methods. To assess robustness without per-frame ground truth in adverse weather, we further propose a novel proxy metric, Environment-Based KL Divergence (EBKL), under which 4D radar proves a reliable and efficient modality for 3D semantic occupancy prediction. The dataset and code will be publicly available.
blocks.zh: 3D语义占用预测对于自主驾驶至关重要,但相机方法在低光条件下降解,而LiDAR方法对不利天气敏感. 4D雷达的强度更强,然而它的相撞性以及高成本的雷达拉伸处理限制了它的使用. 我们提出雷达几何-语义占用预测(RadarGSOCC),这是一个有效的框架,通过单独提取几何和语义特征,包括多普勒信息,直接处理4D雷达的收分数,其关键组成部分是可变形的基于注意力的几何精密模块。 我们还引入了K-Radar 3DSemOcc基准,这是第一个使用4D雷达测距器进行3D语义占用预测的大规模基准,该基准建立在K-Radar数据集上,并配有精细的以LiDAR为基础的说明. RadarGSOC在51.2米范围内预测了15个类别,实现了38.2%的IoU,7.6%的mIoU,以及25.5%的加权mIoU,在加权mIoU中表现优于17%的相对(25.5对21.9),同时使用了较少的参数和较低的计算. 它大大改进了卡车预测,同时交换了汽车的准确性,超过了以相机为基础的方法,并缩小了与以LiDAR为基础的方法的差距。 为了评估在恶劣天气中没有按框架地面真实性的稳健性,我们进一步提议采用新的代用计量标准,即基于环境的KL Divergence(EBKL),根据该计量标准,4D雷达证明是3D语义占用预测的可靠而有效的模式。 数据集和代码将公开提供。

blocks.en: 3D semantic occupancy prediction enables autonomous vehicles to understand their 3D surroundings and identify safe navigable space for planning. By assigning an occupancy state and a semantic class to every voxel, it captures free space, drivable area, and objects of arbitrary shape that bounding-box detection cannot represent [ 2 , 1 ] . While camera- and LiDAR-based methods perform well under ideal conditions, they inherit the limitations of their sensors: cameras lose most of their information in low-light conditions, and LiDAR is severely degraded by rain, snow, and fog [ 3 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 3D语义占用预测使自主车辆能够了解其3D周围环境并识别安全可航行空间进行规划. 通过将占用状态和语义类分给每个阴道,它捕捉自由空间,可驾驶区域,以及任意形状的物体,边框检测不能代表[2, 1]. 虽然以相机和LiDAR为基础的方法在理想条件下表现良好,但它们继承了传感器的局限性:相机在低光条件下失去大部分信息,而LiDAR被雨,雪,雾等严重退化[3,4].

blocks.en: 4D radar provides a robust alternative. Millimeter-wave signals are largely insensitive to precipitation, fog, and illumination, and FMCW 4D radars measure the range, azimuth, elevation, and Doppler velocity of every reflection [ 5 , 6 ] . The raw 4D radar tensor (4DRT) retains the full power spectrum before any thresholding [ 5 ] , and its Doppler dimension directly encodes the radial velocity of each return, a strong cue for separating moving objects from static structures. Exploiting 4DRTs for dense prediction is nevertheless challenging: the tensor is large and noisy, so aggressive sparsification is required [ 7 ] ; its low angular resolution blurs fine structures; and the Doppler dimension mixes power and velocity information that standard backbones do not readily consume [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 4D雷达提供了强大的替代品. 毫米波信号对降水、雾和发光基本不敏感,FMCW 4D雷达测量每个反射的射程、方位角、高程和多普勒速度[5、6]。 原始的4D雷达测距仪(4DRT)在任何阈值前保留了全部功率频谱,及其 多普勒维度直接编码了每次返回的光圈速度,这是将移动的物体从静态结构中分离出来的强烈提示. 然而,利用4DRT进行密集预测仍具有挑战性:收音机大而吵闹,因此需要进行猛烈的溅射[7];其低角分辨率模糊了精细的结构;多普勒维度混合了电能和速度信息,标准骨干不易消耗[8].

blocks.en: Radar-based occupancy prediction has only recently emerged. RadarOcc [ 7 ] was the first to predict 3D occupancy directly from 4DRTs, and subsequent methods improve accuracy through LiDAR supervision [ 9 ] or camera–radar fusion [ 10 , 11 ] , but require additional sensors. More importantly, existing radar-only methods underutilize Doppler cues: when we reproduce RadarOcc on our benchmark, its performance remains nearly unchanged with or without the Doppler input (Table I ).
blocks.zh: 最近才出现雷达占用预测。 RadarOcc [7]是第一个从4DRT直接预测出3D入地的,随后的方法通过LiDAR监督[9]或相机-雷达聚变[10,11]来提高精度,但需要额外的传感器. 更重要的是,现有的雷达方法利用不足 多普勒提示:当我们按基准复制雷达Occ时,其性能无论多普勒输入与否都几乎保持不变(表一.

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose RadarGSOcc , a Doppler-aware 3D semantic occupancy framework using 4D radar tensors. Our key idea is to extract the geometric (spatial power) and semantic (Doppler-related) information of the tensor separately and then fuse them. To this end, we introduce a geometric-semantic feature extraction module that processes the power and Doppler channels through separate sparse-convolution and deformable-attention branches [ 12 , 13 ] before fusing them, and a lightweight geometric refinement module in the occupancy head that is designed to recover fine-grained structures, such as small objects, using the geometric features.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出RadarGSOcc,一个多普勒-意识的3D语义占用框架,使用4D雷达收发器. 我们的关键思想是分别取取出收发热器的几何(空间功率)和语义(多普勒相关)信息,再将收热器引信. 为此,我们引入了几何-语义特征提取模块,在相接前通过分化的稀有和可变形的分支[12,13]来处理功率和多普勒通道,并在占用头中引入一个轻量级几何精细模块,以利用几何特征来回收小物体等细纹结构.

blocks.en: We also construct the K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark, the first large-scale benchmark for fine-grained 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors, built from the K-Radar dataset [ 5 ] . It contains 14 semantic classes and an empty class over 5,910 training and 1,781 test frames. Labels are generated by a LiDAR-based occupancy model [ 1 ] and refined with the 3D bounding-box annotations of K-Radar, which more than doubles the number of moving-object voxels.
blocks.zh: 我们还构建了K-Radar 3DSemOcc基准,这是第一个使用由K-Radar数据集所构建的4D雷达测距器进行精细3D语义占用预测的大规模基准[5]. 它包含14个语义课和1个超过5,910个训练的空课和1,781个测试框. 标签由基于LiDAR的占用模型[1]所生成,并用K-Radar的3D边框-框注来精炼,它比移动对象的活塞多出一倍多.

blocks.en: On this benchmark, RadarGSOcc achieves 7.6% mIoU and 25.5% weighted mIoU within a 51.2 m range, improving the weighted mIoU of RadarOcc by 16% relative (25.5 vs. 21.9) while using 11% fewer parameters and 5% fewer FLOPs ; averaged over three training runs, the weighted mIoU is 23.8% vs. 20.9%. The gain comes mainly from large static classes such as drivable area, vegetation, and terrain. Vehicles remain difficult: RadarGSOcc improves truck/bus IoU but loses car IoU, and RadarOcc remains better when the two classes are merged into a single vehicle class. RadarGSOcc also outperforms camera-based [ 1 , 14 ] and camera–radar fusion methods [ 1 , 11 ] , and narrows the gap with LiDAR-based approaches. Under adverse weather (e.g., rain, sleet, and snow), where camera and LiDAR degrade, its predictions remain more consistent. Since reliable ground truth is unavailable in such conditions, we propose a proxy metric, Environment-Based KL Divergence (EBKL) , which compares the predicted class distribution under a given weather condition with the normal-condition reference of the same environment. Under EBKL, 4D radar tensors give the lowest divergence of the three modalities in adverse weather.
blocks.zh: 在这个基准上,雷达地面观测中心实现了 在51.2米范围内的mIoU和25.5%的加权mIoU,使雷达Occ的加权mIoU相对提高了16%(25.5对21.9),同时使用了11%的参数和5%的FLOP;平均在三次训练中,加权mIoU是23.8%对20.9%。 收益主要来自大型静态类,如可驾驶地,植被,地势等. 车辆仍然困难:RadarGSOC改进了卡车/客车IoU,但损失了汽车IoU,当将两个等级合并为一个车辆等级时,RadarOcc仍然较好. RadarGSOC还超越了基于相机的[1,14]和相机-雷达聚变方法[1,11],并缩小了与基于LiDAR的方法的差距. 在恶劣天气下(如:雨,雪等),相机和LiDAR会退化,其预测仍然更加一致. 由于在这种条件下无法获得可靠的地面真相,我们提议采用一种代用计量标准,即基于环境的KL Divergence(EBKL),将在特定天气条件下的预测类分布与同一环境的正常条件参照进行比较。 在EBKL下,4D雷达收发器在恶劣天气下给出了三种模式中最低的分量.

blocks.en: In summary, the contributions of this paper are as follows:
blocks.zh: 概括地说,本文件的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark : the first large-scale benchmark for fine-grained 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors. • RadarGSOcc : an efficient Doppler-aware framework whose geometric-semantic feature extraction and geometric refinement modules improve radar-based occupancy prediction with fewer parameters and FLOPs than RadarOcc. • Robustness and proxy metric : a proxy metric (EBKL) for evaluating prediction consistency without ground truth, and an evaluation showing that 4D radar tensors give more consistent predictions than camera and LiDAR under adverse weather.

blocks.en: II RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A 4D Radar Datasets
blocks.zh: II-A 4D (韩语) 雷达数据集

blocks.en: Large-scale camera and LiDAR datasets have significantly advanced autonomous driving research [ 15 , 16 ] . In contrast, 4D radar datasets remain limited despite their robustness in adverse weather [ 17 , 18 , 5 , 19 ] . Early datasets such as Astyx [ 17 ] contain only 500 frames, while VoD [ 19 ] and TJ4DRadSet [ 18 ] mainly focus on urban scenes under clear conditions. K-Radar [ 5 ] addresses these limitations by providing 35,000 frames of 4D radar tensor data across diverse weather conditions, including rain, fog, and snow. However, it lacks annotations for 3D semantic occupancy prediction, motivating our proposed benchmark.
blocks.zh: 大型相机和LiDAR数据集拥有显著的自主驱动研究[15,16]. 相形之下,4D雷达数据集尽管在恶劣天气中坚固性能仍然有限[17,18,5,19]. Astyx [17]等早期数据集仅包含500帧,而VOD [19]和TJ4DRadSet [18] 则主要以清晰条件下的城市场景为主. K-Radar [5] 解决了这些限制,提供了35 000帧的4D雷达拉伸数据,涵盖雨、雾和雪等各种天气条件。 然而,它缺乏3D语义占用率预测的说明,激励了我们拟议的基准。

blocks.en: II-B 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
blocks.zh: II-B 3D 语义占用预测

blocks.en: 3D semantic occupancy prediction enables holistic scene understanding, including free space and drivable areas [ 20 ] . Occ3D [ 2 ] introduced the first large-scale benchmark on nuScenes [ 21 ] . Recent methods improve temporal modeling [ 22 ] , point completion [ 23 ] , multi-camera prediction [ 24 , 3 ] , and unified occupancy frameworks [ 1 ] . Other works focus on efficiency and robustness through Gaussian-based occupancy [ 25 , 26 ] , sparse prediction [ 27 , 28 ] , label-noise handling [ 29 ] , and projection consistency [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 3D语义占用预测可以实现整体的场景理解,包括空闲空间和可驾驶区域 [20]. Occ3D [2] 在nuScens上引入了第一个大规模基准 [21]. 最近的方法改进了时间模型[22]、点完成[23]、多相机预测[24、3]和统一占用框架 [一]. 其他作品则通过高斯人入住[25,26],零星预测[27,28],标签-噪声处理[29],和预测一致性[30]来关注效率和稳健性.

blocks.en: II-C 4D Radar-based Perception
blocks.zh: II-C 4D 雷达传感器

blocks.en: Early 4D radar research mainly focused on object detection. Methods such as RPFA-Net [ 31 ] and SMURF [ 32 ] adapt LiDAR-based frameworks and reduce noise, while fusion-based approaches [ 33 , 18 , 34 ] improve performance but are typically evaluated in clear-weather conditions. For direct radar tensor processing, RTNH and RTNH+ [ 5 , 35 ] learn radar-specific representations for 3D detection.
blocks.zh: 早期的4D雷达研究主要集中于物体探测. RPFA-Net[31]和SMURF[32]等方法适应基于LiDAR的框架并减少噪音,而基于聚变的方法[33,18,34]则提高了性能,但通常在晴天条件下进行评估. 对于直接的雷达收音机处理,RTNH和RTNH+[5,35]学习雷达专用的表示来进行3D探测.

blocks.en: Recently, radar-based occupancy prediction has emerged. RadarOcc [ 7 ] first applies 4D radar tensors to 3D occupancy prediction using transformer-based architectures [ 36 , 2 ] . Subsequent works improve performance through LiDAR supervision [ 9 ] , camera-radar fusion [ 10 ] , and multi-modal learning [ 11 , 37 , 38 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近出现了基于雷达的入住预测. RadarOcc [7]首先使用以变压器为主的架构对3D占用率预测应用了4D雷达测距器[36,2]. 随后的作品通过LiDAR监督[9],相机-雷达聚变[10],以及多模式学习[11,37,38]来提高性能.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, existing methods often struggle with accurate semantic prediction and rely on computationally expensive transformer architectures. In contrast, we propose an efficient framework that leverages geometric-semantic feature extraction and lightweight refinement for 3D semantic occupancy prediction from 4D radar tensors.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但现有方法往往与准确的语义预测相冲突并依赖于计算成本昂贵的变压器架构. 相比之下,我们提出一个有效的框架,利用几何-语义特征提取和轻量级改进,对从4D雷达测距仪得出的3D语义占用情况进行预测。

blocks.en: There is no large-scale dataset with fine-grained 3D semantic occupancy labels for 4D radar tensors: RadarOcc [ 7 ] evaluates on K-Radar with occupancy labels that distinguish only foreground and background. To address this, we build a new benchmark based on K-Radar [ 5 ] . Following prior work [ 2 , 1 ] , we generate pseudo-labels from LiDAR using a single-frame strategy due to inaccurate odometry [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 4D雷达收发器没有带有精细的3D语义占用标签的大型数据集: RadarOcc [7] 在K-Radar上评价,占用标签只区分前缘和背景. 为了解决这个问题,我们根据K-Radar[5]建立了一个新的基准。 继前作[2, 1]后,我们使用单帧策略从LiDAR中生成出伪标签,原因是不准确的odometry [35].

blocks.en: The labeling pipeline has two stages:
blocks.zh: 标签管道有两个阶段:

blocks.en: (1) Initial labeling: The LiDAR-based CONet-L model of OpenOccupancy [ 1 ] , trained on nuScenes [ 21 ] , generates 17-class pseudo-labels. We select scenes 2, 5, 8, 9, 10, 14, 16, 17, and 20 for training, and 3, 6, and 15 for testing; all of these scenes are recorded under normal weather conditions, and their environment, time of day, and number of frames are listed in Table S-I of the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: (1)初始标签:基于LiDAR的CONet-L型OpenOccupancy [1],接受nuScenes[21]培训,生成17级伪标签. 我们选择了场景2,5,8,9,10,14,16,17,和20进行训练,以及3,6,15进行测试;所有这些场景都是在正常天气条件下录制的,其环境,时间,帧数列于补充材料表S-I.

blocks.en: (2) Label refinement: The pseudo-labels are refined with the 3D bounding-box annotations of K-Radar by assigning the object class (e.g., car, truck/bus, pedestrian) to the voxels within each bounding box. This more than doubles the number of moving-object voxels in the training split, from about 365k to 768k (Tables S-II and S-III ).

blocks.en: Fig. 2 shows an example in which refinement recovers cars and trucks. We further simplify labels by merging bus and truck classes and removing construction vehicles. Manual verification of 525 randomly sampled non-empty voxels (threshold 0.8) gives an accuracy of 91.8% (482 correct); per-class results, including the moving-object classes, are reported in Table S-IV of the supplementary material together with the verification protocol. blocks.en: III-B 1 4D Radar Tensor Preprocessing
blocks.zh: III-B 1 4D 雷达传感器预处理

blocks.en: The overall architecture of RadarGSOcc is shown in Fig. 3 . We follow the preprocessing strategy of RadarOcc [ 7 ] . Specifically, azimuth, range, and elevation are concatenated, and for each spatial element we extract the top-3 power values along the Doppler dimension together with their Doppler indices. To reduce computation, we keep only the top 250 values per range bin instead of using percentile-based sparsification [ 35 ] . This produces a sparse 4D radar tensor that preserves key motion and structural information.
blocks.zh: RadarGSOC的整体架构如图3所示. 我们遵循雷达组织预处理策略 具体地说,方位角,范围,和高程是相接的, 对于每个空间元素,我们从多普勒维度上提取出顶- 3 个功率值及其多普勒指数。 为了减少计算量,我们只保留每个范围的最大250个值,而不是使用以百分位为基础的垃圾邮件[35]。 这会产生一个稀少的4D雷达收发器,能保存关键运动和结构信息.

blocks.en: The final representation has 8 channels: the top-3 power values, the top-3 Doppler indices, and the mean and variance of the power along the Doppler dimension (Section S-II of the supplementary material). This design follows RadarOcc while enabling efficient use of Doppler information for 3D semantic occupancy prediction.

blocks.en: The network is trained in a fully supervised manner using ground-truth occupancy labels. Following [ 10 ] , we adopt the cross-entropy loss L C ​ E \textit{L}_{CE} as the primary objective. To address class imbalance, we additionally employ the Lovász-Softmax loss L l ​ o ​ v ​ a ​ s ​ z ​ - ​ s ​ o ​ f ​ t ​ m ​ a ​ x \textit{L}_{lovasz\text{-}softmax} [ 42 ] . To further improve geometric and semantic consistency, we incorporate geometric and class-wise affinity losses, L g ​ e ​ o \textit{L}_{geo} and L s ​ e ​ m \textit{L}_{sem} , as proposed in [ 43 ] . blocks.en: IV EXPERIMENTS
blocks.zh: 四. 警告

blocks.en: IV-A Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: We compare RadarGSOcc with the camera-, LiDAR-, radar point cloud-, and camera–radar fusion baselines of OpenOccupancy [ 1 ] , with BEVFormer [ 14 ] and 4DRC-Occ [ 11 ] , and with the 4D radar tensor-based RadarOcc [ 7 ] . For ablation, we evaluate RadarGSOcc variants without geometric refinement, without geometric-semantic fusion, and with standard 3D convolution refinement. For a fair comparison, RadarOcc and RadarGSOcc use the same feature dimension of 192. The prediction range is 0–51.2 m forward, ± \pm 25.6 m laterally, and − 2.6 -2.6 – + 3.0 +3.0 m vertically, with a voxel grid of 128 × 128 × 14 128\times 128\times 14 and 0.4 m resolution. Models are trained on the 5,910 frames of the training scenes and evaluated on the 1,781 frames of the test scenes, covering diverse urban and highway environments under day and night conditions. All 4D radar point cloud-, camera-, and LiDAR-based methods follow their original training settings. OpenOcc-L (64) and OpenOcc-L (128) denote the LiDAR-based model with 64- and 128-channel LiDAR inputs, respectively. Since the official code of 4DRC-Occ is not publicly available, we use our own reproduction of its version-A model, implemented in the OpenOccupancy framework with the hyperparameters reported in the original paper; because the original results are reported on a different dataset, the reproduction could not be checked against them.

In the K-Radar dataset, environments include urban, university-campus, and highway scenarios. EBKL assumes that the class distribution remains relatively consistent within the same environment, allowing distributional consistency under adverse weather to be evaluated using the divergence from the normal-condition distribution. Therefore, we compute EBKL only over a class subset 𝒞 E \mathcal{C}_{E} consisting of relatively stable background classes (drivable area, terrain, manmade, barrier, and vegetation) and frequently occurring moving-object classes (car and truck); both distributions are renormalized over 𝒞 E \mathcal{C}_{E} . This assumption is examined in Section S-V of the supplementary material, which shows that highway scenes are well separated from the other environments, whereas the urban and university-campus distributions are close to each other. The assumption may not hold across datasets with substantially different scene distributions, such as K-Radar versus nuScenes [ 21 ] or Waymo [ 44 ] ; therefore, EBKL may be less reliable for cross-dataset comparisons. Since EBKL measures only the divergence between voxel-class distributions and does not evaluate voxel-level semantic accuracy, it cannot replace IoU-based metrics: in particular, a degenerate predictor that outputs the normal-condition class distribution regardless of its input would obtain EBKL = 0 =0 . We therefore use EBKL only as a proxy metric for prediction consistency when ground-truth occupancy labels are unavailable under adverse weather, always together with the non-empty voxel ratio (Table VI ) and qualitative results (Fig. 1 ); its use is supported by its strong negative correlation with mIoU across models under normal conditions (Fig. 6 ).

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Visualization of 3D semantic occupancy prediction using LiDAR (OpenOcc-L) [ 1 ] , camera (OpenOcc-C) [ 1 ] , and 4D radar tensors with RadarOcc [ 7 ] and the proposed RadarGSOcc in urban (1) and highway (2) scenarios. blocks.en: As shown in Table II , RadarGSOcc reaches 25.5% W-mIoU, a 16% relative improvement over RadarOcc [ 7 ] (21.9%), with about 11% fewer parameters and 5% fewer FLOPs (Table IV ), although its frame rate is slightly lower (3.1 vs. 3.3 FPS). The improvement comes mainly from the large static classes that dominate the voxel-weighted average: drivable area (42.2% vs. 40.4%), vegetation (21.2% vs. 16.3%), and terrain (23.9% vs. 18.0%). For vehicles, the result is mixed. RadarGSOcc attains the highest truck/bus IoU of all methods (4.7%), but its car IoU drops from 6.3% to 0.6%, and when car and truck/bus are merged into a single vehicle class, RadarOcc remains better than RadarGSOcc (6.5% vs. 2.6% IoU). The higher truck/bus IoU therefore does not translate into better vehicle occupancy overall, and vehicle prediction from 4D radar tensors remains an open problem. Removing the channel overlap reduces W-mIoU by 3.7 points (25.5% → \rightarrow 21.8%) and truck/bus IoU from 4.7% to 2.1%, while recovering some rare small-object classes (e.g., trailer and pedestrian; Table S-VI ), indicating that the shared Doppler-index channels mainly benefit the dominant classes.

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Training with Different Random Seeds
blocks.zh: 使用不同随机种子的培训

blocks.en: We train RadarGSOcc and the baseline RadarOcc [ 7 ] three times with different random seeds to evaluate training robustness (Table S-VIII of the supplementary material). Averaged over the three runs, RadarGSOcc achieves 37.43% ± \pm 2.34% IoU, 7.14% ± \pm 0.41% mIoU, and 23.83% ± \pm 2.15% W-mIoU, compared with 36.26% ± \pm 0.23%, 6.72% ± \pm 0.28%, and 20.93% ± \pm 0.90% for RadarOcc. RadarGSOcc is therefore better on average, but not in every run: in the third run, its IoU and mIoU (34.8% and 6.8%) are lower than those of RadarOcc (36.0% and 7.0%), although its W-mIoU remains higher (21.4% vs. 20.8%). RadarGSOcc also shows a much larger run-to-run variation (e.g., ± \pm 2.15 vs. ± \pm 0.90 in W-mIoU), so its training is less stable than that of RadarOcc. Table II and the other tables report the first run of each model, which is also the best of the three runs in W-mIoU for both models.

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies to evaluate geometric-semantic fusion and geometric refinement (Table IV ), in which RadarOcc processes all input channels jointly and applies no refinement in the dense head. Separating the geometric and semantic branches alone (first row) already matches RadarOcc (6.9% vs. 6.7% mIoU) with fewer parameters and FLOPs. Neither module helps on its own: the deformable geometric refinement without fusion changes W-mIoU only marginally (21.8% → \rightarrow 21.1%), and geometric-semantic fusion without refinement slightly degrades it (20.7%), while refining the fused features with standard 3D convolution degrades it further (18.1%), indicating that a local convolutional refinement cannot exploit the fused geometric features. Only the combination of fusion and deformable-attention refinement yields a clear gain, raising W-mIoU to 25.5% (+3.7 over the base model and +7.4 over convolutional refinement; 23.8% on average over three runs, Section IV-D2 ) at a cost of only +0.4M parameters and +13 GFLOPs. The two modules therefore appear complementary: fusion injects Doppler-informed cues into the geometric features, and the deformable refinement allows the occupancy head to exploit them. Because each variant is trained once and the run-to-run standard deviation of RadarGSOcc is about 2 points in W-mIoU (Section IV-D2 ), differences of about one point among the other variants should not be over-interpreted. The geometric refinement module slightly lowers the frame rate (3.2 → \rightarrow 3.1 FPS) but improves W-mIoU. In the examples of Fig. 5 , the refined features respond more strongly to moving objects (cars and trucks) and road structures.

We evaluate RadarGSOcc under adverse weather conditions on the unlabeled adverse-weather sequences of the K-Radar dataset (Fig. 1 and Table S-I ). Since reliable per-frame ground truth is unavailable, we use the non-empty voxel ratio (how much occupancy a
model predicts) and the proposed EBKL (how close its class distribution stays to the normal-condition reference) as complementary proxies. As shown in Fig. 1 (right), RadarGSOcc attains lower EBKL than the camera- and LiDAR-based methods in rain, sleet, light snow, and heavy snow. Across the nine models evaluated under normal weather, lower EBKL goes with higher mIoU (Fig. 6 ; Pearson correlation coefficient − 0.87 -0.87 ), indicating that EBKL tracks mIoU. Table VI is consistent with this: LiDAR collapses under sleet, fog, and snow (e.g., 29.8% → \rightarrow 9.5% in fog), the camera model is stable but low, and RadarGSOcc preserves most of its occupancy through sleet, rain, and fog. Because the adverse-weather sequences also differ from the normal-weather test scenes in environment and time of day (Table S-I ), both proxies reflect scene changes as well as weather. Overall, 4D radar tensors give the most consistent predictions of the three modalities, with snow as the main failure case [ 8 ] .

blocks.en: V CONCLUSION AND FUTURE WORK
blocks.zh: 五、结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce the K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark, the first large-scale benchmark for fine-grained 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors. Built on the K-Radar dataset [ 5 ] , it is generated using LiDAR-based occupancy prediction with refinement from radar annotations, covering diverse urban and highway scenes under day and night conditions. We also propose RadarGSOcc, an efficient framework that leverages geometric-semantic feature extraction and geometric refinement for 3D semantic occupancy prediction from 4D radar tensors. RadarGSOcc achieves 25.5% weighted mIoU and 7.6% mIoU, a 16% relative improvement over RadarOcc [ 7 ] in weighted mIoU, while using 11% fewer parameters and 5% fewer FLOPs. It also outperforms camera-based [ 1 , 14 ] and camera–radar fusion methods, and gives more consistent predictions than camera and LiDAR under adverse weather such as rain, sleet, and snow. Its main limitations are vehicle prediction, where RadarOcc remains better when car and truck/bus are merged, and a larger run-to-run variation than RadarOcc.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了K-Radar 3DSemOcc基准,这是第一个使用4D雷达测距仪进行精细3D语义占用预测的大规模基准. 它建于K-Radar数据集 [5]上,使用基于LiDAR的入住预测,从雷达说明中精细化而来,覆盖了昼夜条件下的各种城市和高速公路场景. 我们还提出雷达GSOCC,这是一个有效的框架,利用几何-语义特征提取和几何精细化,从4D雷达测距仪进行三维语义占用预测. RadarGSOC实现了25.5%的加权毫升和7.6%的微升,比加权毫升微升的RadarOcc[7]有16%的相对改进,同时使用了11%的参数和5%的FLOP. 它还比基于相机的[1,14]和相机-雷达聚变方法要强,在雨,雪等不利天气下比相机和LiDAR更能作出一致的预测. 其主要局限在于车辆预测,当汽车和卡车/客车合并时,雷达OCC仍然较好,而且运行的变异比雷达OCC更大.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we propose Environment-Based KL Divergence (EBKL) as a proxy metric to evaluate prediction consistency under adverse weather without ground truth. RadarGSOcc achieves better results in both EBKL and qualitative visualization, highlighting the effectiveness of 4D radar for robust 3D semantic occupancy prediction in adverse weather.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们提议采用基于环境的KL Divergence(EBKL)作为一种代用衡量标准,在没有地面真相的情况下评价恶劣天气下的预测一致性。 RadarGSOcc在EBKL和定性可视化方面都取得了更好的成果,突出了4D雷达在恶劣天气中用于强力的3D语义占用预测的效果.

blocks.en: For future work, we aim to improve vehicle prediction and training stability, improve label quality using larger-scale datasets with accurate human annotations, and further advance robust 4D radar-based occupancy prediction in real-world environments.
blocks.zh: 对于今后的工作,我们的目标是提高车辆预测和培训稳定性,利用带有准确人文说明的更大规模数据集来提高标签质量,并进一步推动在现实世界环境中以4D为主的强力雷达占用率预测。

blocks.en: The geometric and semantic branches use a feature dimension of 96 each, so that their concatenation matches the 192-dimensional occupancy features used in the refinement module and in RadarOcc. blocks.en: Table S-VIII lists the results of the three training runs of RadarOcc and RadarGSOcc that are summarized in Section IV-D2 of the main paper. The first run of each model was trained without a fixed random seed and is the run reported in Table II and the other tables of the main paper; the second and third runs use seeds 1111 and 2222. The means and standard deviations are computed from the unrounded values.

blocks.en: S-VII Data Behind the mIoU–EBKL Correlation
blocks.zh: 第 七 类 mIOU-EBKL 关联后的数据

blocks.en: Table S-IX lists the mIoU (Table II ) and the EBKL under normal weather of the nine models used for Fig. 6 of the main paper. Over these nine models, the Pearson correlation coefficient between mIoU and EBKL is − 0.87 -0.87 (Spearman rank correlation − 0.95 -0.95 ): models with higher mIoU have lower EBKL.
blocks.zh: 表S-IX列出了主要论文图6使用的9个模型的正常天气下mIoU(表二)和EBKL. 在这9个模型中,mIoU和EBKL之间的皮尔逊关联系数为−0.87-0.87(斯皮尔曼排名关联为−0.95-0.95):mIoU较高的模型具有较低的EBKL.
